## Why This Is Asked

- Drift detection with Clarify

## Code Example

```python
# drift check stub
def drift_metric(ref, cur, feat='text'):
    from scipy.stats import ks_2samp
    stat, p = ks_2samp(ref[feat], cur[feat])
    return stat
```
